explication: PAL MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI client invoke specialized coding tools and consult multiple model providers while maintaining conversation context. The primary path is client request → server tool dispatch → simple or guided workflow execution → model response returned through the server; conversation state supports continuity across turns. The README also documents multi-pass review, planning, debugging and other coding workflows, plus clink’s external CLI bridge. Sampled source confirms server dispatch, shared tool/workflow infrastructure, and provider registries; unsampled tool wiring is not expanded.
